== Walkthrough ==

''NOTE: May be broken now due to recent updates[https://www.project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=424716]. Currently not working on Green (5/2025)''

You say, 'Hail, Wista'

: Wista says 'Hi, do ya likes eatin', or puhaps Hukulk sent ya?  I makes many gud eats. Doh, sum I can'ts make cause sum tings I ain't gots.  I cud makes some berry tastie stuff wid only [sum wolf meat].'

You say, 'I get sum wolf meat.'

: Wista says 'Gets me two wolf meats sos I cans makes me foods.  I gib ya sumting.'

Turn in 2 x [[Wolf Meat]].

: Wista says 'Deez berry gud.  Makes berry good suff.  Me berry happy.  Yous gets more bring dem ta mees.  Yous takes dis and tanks fer da meats.'

<div class="facblock">
* Your faction standing with [[Grobb Merchants]] got better.
</div>
{{YouGainExperience}}

{{:Wolf Meat }} can be found in many zones, including [[Nektulos Forest]], [[Qeynos Hills]], and the Karanas.

It takes approximately 35 stacks to go from Dubious (starting for good races) to Apprehensive (will buy/sell).  For a human paladin of Rodcet using DE illusion, it took 7 stacks to get to apprehensive, and 16 for indifferent, but without the illusion faction is still dubious.
